title: HuggingFace: Security.txt
summary: HuggingFace has published a security.txt file at huggingface.co/security.txt, a standardized disclosure mechanism (RFC 9116) that tells security researchers how to report vulnerabilities. The Hacker News discussion (265 points, 68 comments) likely covers the practice of security.txt adoption, HuggingFace's security posture, and implications for the AI/ML platform ecosystem.
